limitations: Presentation curves only; independent verification must certify the actual delivered polylines before packaging.
The deviation budget is measured directly against the original unsimplified shared network, not against a previous simplified version.
Narrow contacts can require locally weaker filtering or exact source retention.

policy.coordinateDerivation: New samples from the filtered unsimplified shared source network; never read previous simplified geometries. Exact source coordinates retained at all shared junctions.
policy.displayUse: single source-generalized internal-boundary representation at every zoom
policy.method: Arclength Gaussian filtering of unsimplified source paths before small-error render resampling; degree-two provincial arcs join before filtering, with zero-derivative shared-junction corrections.
